Class BlueJEditorListener

java.lang.Object
tt.uwi.collection.BlueJEditorListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.editor.DocumentListener
public class BlueJEditorListener extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.editor.DocumentListener
Receives text-edit notifications from a BlueJ Java editor and publishes editor-activity telemetry for the associated class.

  • Method Details

    • textReplaced

      public void textReplaced(int position, String removedText, String insertedText, int linesRemoved, int linesAdded)
      Handles a text replacement in the associated BlueJ editor document. Publishes one editor-activity event carrying the current class name. The replacement position and text/line counts are received for callback compatibility but are not included in the telemetry event.
      Specified by:
      textReplaced in interface bluej.extensions2.editor.DocumentListener
      Parameters:
      position - the replacement position in the document
      removedText - the text removed by the replacement
      insertedText - the text inserted by the replacement
      linesRemoved - the number of lines removed
      linesAdded - the number of lines added
